theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_mm_massOn_le_liminf
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ Us j) → ConvergesWeakly Ss C → ∀ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ → ∀ O : Set (Euclid P), C.massOn O ≤ liminf (fun i => (Ss (φ i)).massOn O) atTop
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
